children: IDBI Bank on Saturday reported a 39 per cent fall in net profit to ₹2,205 crore for the second quarter ended September 2026, as non-interest income moderated.
The LIC-controlled bank earned a profit of ₹3,627 crore in the year-ago period, including a one-off gain of ₹1,699 crore from the sale of its strategic investment in NSDL.

title: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit falls 39% to ₹2,205 cr as non-interest income moderates
